summary: First Seacoast Bancorp filed an 8-K on May 4, 2026, announcing a merger agreement with Cambridge Financial Group. Under the terms, each share of First Seacoast common stock will be converted into $17.25 in cash. The merger is subject to regulatory and stockholder approval, with closing expected in Q3 2026. The company agreed not to solicit alternative proposals, subject to fiduciary exceptions. A $3.5 million break fee applies if the company terminates under certain circumstances. Entered voting agreements with directors and officers. Watch for regulatory clearance and stockholder vote risk-arb.
